attempt: Reach Moss through a burning cabin.
interference: Separated fire blocks cut across the direct route while Moss remains seated.
change: He ignores storage, sends water towards the wolf and reaches forward before the film cuts.
purpose: Open with danger, relationship priority and an honestly withheld outcome.
reveal: The protagonist is already too late for an event whose cause is still unknown.
visual: Water passes a burning chest; Moss appears beyond flame for one instant.
audio: Fire, breaking blocks and one distressed wolf sound overtake a short narration line.

attempt: Cross an unvisited ravine before night and understand the burned construction.
interference: A player-built stone shell and descending stair contradict the map edge and private-world history.
change: He follows the surviving geometry towards purple light rather than leaving.
purpose: Ground the title mystery in persistent environment rather than a person.
reveal: The ruin has practical construction logic but no available builder.
visual: L-shaped foundation, granite notch, stone chest recess and missing timber align above the ravine.
audio: Wind and footsteps yield gradually to a portal hum.

attempt: Inspect the active frame without committing to it.
interference: Blast damage, exposed lava and a plank remnant explain activation conditions but not authorship or destination.
change: No ordinary explanation survives, so he chooses to enter.
purpose: Honour the portal promise through protagonist agency.
reveal: The frame is complete and active beside a recent physical event.
visual: Hand traces the cobblestone foot before crossing the portal plane.
audio: Portal ambience replaces restrained narration at the decision.

attempt: Determine whether he reached another location or an earlier state.
interference: The portal vanishes behind him and every player block is absent.
change: Matching natural landmarks prove the pristine ravine is the same place.
reveal: He stands before the construction he already saw destroyed.
visual: Bare north wall, intact granite seam and untouched west shelf repeat opening angles.
audio: Transition noise falls into ordinary cave and evening ambience.

attempt: Survive the first night and deal with a nearby wolf after a skeleton fight.
interference: The skeleton creates danger before leaving only a small number of bones.
change: The final taming attempt succeeds and Moss follows him to the shelter.
purpose: Begin rapport through normal survival causality.
reveal: The companion central to the cold open enters through earned gameplay.
visual: Skeleton drops bones; taming hearts appear; Moss crosses the threshold behind him.
audio: Combat gives way to the wolf’s ordinary panting and a restrained note of relief.

attempt: Turn the shelter into a workable home while continuing ravine mining.
interference: Moss gets into build spaces, needs feeding after damage and cannot safely follow near lava.
change: A repeated sit-before-mining and release-on-return routine becomes natural between them.
purpose: Make the relationship lived, specific and mechanically consequential.
reveal: The bedside sit state is a safety habit rather than confinement.
visual: Moss blocks a stair placement, follows on timber runs and waits beside the bed at dusk.
audio: Tool rhythm, door sounds and feeding replace heavy exposition.

attempt: Finish the cabin foundation around the terrain.
interference: The granite notch, chest recess and stair rib reproduce details he saw in the ruin.
change: A matched overlook confirms that he is building the burned cabin.
purpose: Turn environmental familiarity into future recognition.
reveal: The opening ruin belongs to the life he is making with Moss.
visual: Past and ruin compositions align on the L-shaped foundation.
audio: Construction sounds stop as remembered opening ambience returns briefly.

attempt: Remove Moss and himself from the threatened future.
interference: Night travel is unsafe and the lava shelf beneath the timber route remains the clearest hazard.
change: He plans departure at dawn, stone-clads the stair and chooses to neutralise the lava first.
purpose: Give him a credible, active prevention strategy.
reveal: He does not accept the ruin or wait passively for it.
visual: Packed supplies sit by the door while stone replaces exposed stair sections.
audio: Measured narration lays out the plan over real inventory and block actions.

attempt: Cool the lava, collect return-frame material and keep Moss away from the mine.
interference: One stripped-spruce support remains continuous behind the new stone facing.
change: He seats Moss beside the bed and mines the last visible obsidian block under running water.
purpose: Join the relationship routine, prevention plan and fire geometry.
reveal: The apparent firebreak is incomplete in a way the opening ruin fairly showed.
visual: Camera traces stone cladding while briefly revealing the concealed log seam.
audio: Water and pickaxe rhythm mask the first distant fire crackle.

attempt: Contain the newly exposed side flow before it reaches the stair.
interference: Water cools the visible face while lava escapes laterally behind the cladding.
change: The hidden support ignites and carries fire above him.
purpose: Make prevention the ordinary physical cause of the disaster.
reveal: No portal force or unseen person starts the fire.
visual: Lava disappears behind stone; fire appears along the upper timber route.
audio: Water hiss gives way to overhead crackle and Moss’s distant distress.

attempt: Reach Moss without spending a second on the cabin or stored items.
interference: Separated fronts consume the shortest routes and Moss cannot cancel the sit command.
change: He completes the cold-open action but reaches interaction range after the final damage interval.
purpose: Deliver the relationship tragedy without a false property-versus-life choice.
reveal: Moss dies in the same fire whose ruin appeared at the beginning.
visual: Water passes storage; a wall is broken; the empty sitting place remains after flame clears.
audio: Narration falls silent through the attempt and returns only after the fire sound recedes.

attempt: Trace the fire backwards and determine whether any action remains.
interference: The burn path proves that his hidden support and mining operation caused the known ruin.
change: He gathers the mined obsidian and decides the remembered portal may offer one more chance.
purpose: Convert grief and recognition into the final active objective.
reveal: The opening ruin, current fire and portal materials belong to one causal history.
visual: Missing timber leads from the bedside room to the lava shelf and stacked obsidian.
audio: Sparse narration sits over block inspection rather than an explanatory speech.

attempt: Build the exact remembered frame before stopping to rest or resupply.
interference: The cabin fire has destroyed flint and steel, spare iron, shield and much of his food.
change: He reproduces the cobblestone foot and asymmetry, then prepares a lava-and-spruce ignition.
purpose: Pay off the builder mystery through visible work.
reveal: He is the portal’s physical builder, using materials with ordinary origins.
visual: Opening close-ups recur as each block is placed from the causal side.
audio: Mining and placement sounds echo the opening inspection in reverse order.

attempt: Wait for fire to form inside the frame and take him back.
interference: Rescue water removed a torch, the lateral branch is dark and a creeper reaches close range while he watches the plank.
change: The creeper kills him and breaks the lip retaining the ignition lava.
purpose: Make the final reversal an earned interaction of grief, darkness and hostile gameplay.
reveal: The opening blast cavity and absent builder come from this death.
visual: A hiss turns him away from the unlit frame one beat too late.
audio: Portal silence, creeper hiss and explosion replace narration.

attempt: Complete the ignition through the arrangement chosen before death.
interference: The blast removes part of the cradle but also opens lava to the remaining spruce.
change: Fire forms inside the frame, the portal activates and the image matches the earlier entry.
purpose: Close builder, activation and journey questions in one visual pay-off.
reveal: The failed return attempt created the portal that began it.
visual: Drops burn, purple fills the frame and a match cut returns to the entering hand.
audio: Fire catches, portal ambience rises and the proposed final line lands after the visual proof.
